title: Pickaxes (skill)

infobox.Description: Determines, damage, and, stamina, cost with Pickaxes.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Pickaxes is a skill related to Pickaxes weapon class.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
Higher skill level in pickaxes reduces the stamina cost to attack down to -33% and increases damage (against creatures and ores) and knockback up to +141%.
For the details of damage scaling, see Damage mechanics#Skill factor.

sections.heading: Leveling up
sections.text: The player gains 1.5xp per attack when hitting stone or ore deposits.

full_text:
Pickaxes (skill)

Description: Determines, damage, and, stamina, cost with Pickaxes.

Introduction. Pickaxes is a skill related to Pickaxes weapon class.

Effects. Higher skill level in pickaxes reduces the stamina cost to attack down to -33% and increases damage (against creatures and ores) and knockback up to +141%.
For the details of damage scaling, see Damage mechanics#Skill factor.

Leveling up. The player gains 1.5xp per attack when hitting stone or ore deposits.
